paper_metadata.title: HfZrVTaMoWTixNby refractory high-entropy alloys: effect of Ti and Nb on microstructure, phase formation and mechanical properties

evidence.quote: the effect of Ti and Nb elements on the microstructural evolution, phase formation, and mechanical properties of HfZrVTaMoWTixNby RHEAs were systematically studied.

other.getter: 15 g high-purity Ti melted to absorb residual oxygen

evidence.quote: The chamber was evacuated to 5 × 10^-4 Pa and then back filled with pure argon until it reached a pressure of 5 × 10^4 Pa. Before the materials were melted, 15 g high-purity Ti was melted to absorb the residual oxygen in the vacuum chamber. Each ingot weighing 30 g was remelted and flipped eight times to ensure chemical homogeneity and cooled in a water-cooled copper hearth crucible.
